**Financial Data Engineer & FP&A Systems Architect**\
Charlottesville, VA · ricoandre@hotmail.com · [linkedin.com/in/alrico](https://linkedin.com/in/alrico) · Portfolio: [andrerico.github.io/AndreRico](https://andrerico.github.io/AndreRico/)

## Summary

I build the systems finance runs on. At Klabin, one of Brazil's largest pulp-and-paper companies, I
spent a decade building the SAP data warehouse and then the FP&A area on top of it, cutting the close
and reporting cycle from about 4 days to less than 1. Since moving to the US I have built large-scale
data platforms and machine-learning pipelines at Penn State and the University of Pennsylvania.
Registered accountant (Brazil), Anaplan Certified Model Builder, and hands-on engineer in Python and SQL.

## Core skills

**Planning & EPM:** Anaplan · SAP BPC · SAP BW-IP · driver-based planning · financial modeling\
**Finance:** FP&A · close & consolidation · budgeting & forecasting · CAPEX · intercompany & managerial costing\
**Data:** SQL · SAP BW 7.4 on HANA · PostgreSQL · data warehousing · ETL (Pentaho) · Hadoop / Hive\
**Analytics, ML & AI:** Python · statistical modeling · ML on HPC/GPU · LLM integration · Tableau · BusinessObjects\
**Software & cloud:** Django · React · TypeScript · Docker · AWS · Linux · Agile

## Experience

### Senior Application Developer — University of Pennsylvania, Perelman School of Medicine · 2024 – present

- Lead developer of Biofilter, a versioned knowledge platform that integrates more than a dozen public
  databases; its data powers the 13.8M-node knowledge graph behind DRIVE-KG (PSB 2026).
- Statistical genetics and machine-learning research on the Penn Medicine BioBank (260,000+ participants):
  pipelines over billions of genetic variants and multi-terabyte datasets on HPC and GPU clusters.
- Built MyNHANES, a platform that downloads, normalizes and harmonizes NHANES survey data across
  cycles for longitudinal analysis.
- PharmCAT team member: tested the pharmacogenomics tool on AnVIL, Terra, All of Us, UK Biobank,
  DNAnexus and AWS, and built pipeline templates for other researchers.

### Senior Application Developer — Penn State University, College of Agricultural Sciences · 2022 – 2024

- Built IGEM, a gene–exposure knowledge base (25 ETL pipelines, PostgreSQL, FastAPI, public website);
  first-author paper at the Pacific Symposium on Biocomputing 2025.
- Extended and applied CLARITE, a framework for association and interaction analyses in
  population-scale datasets.
- Built a data integration system for heterogeneous clinical-study datasets with PII protection.

### Senior Consultant, FP&A — Klabin S/A, São Paulo · 2018 – 2021

- Led FP&A full time: annual budget, variance analysis, product-mix and margin analysis, long-term
  projections and reports for executive leadership.
- Automated management calculations and chained results; reduced the time to publish results.
- Delivered an integrated CAPEX planning and depreciation model (2019) and a managerial cost and
  intercompany planning system for pricing and inventory valuation across entities (2020).

### Senior Consultant, FP&A and BI — Klabin S/A, São Paulo · 2016 – 2018

- Built the FP&A area inside the enterprise data warehouse, integrating all financial information.
- Redesigned consolidation and management reporting, cutting the close and reporting cycle from
  about 4 days to less than 1; redesigned budgeting and planning on SAP BW-IP and BPC.
- Delivered value-chain cost and EBITDA attribution (2017) and an automated management reporting
  platform (2018); automated management books and earnings releases.

### Business Intelligence Senior — Klabin S/A, São Paulo · 2008 – 2016

- Built and ran the SAP BI platform for finance, forestry, pulp and paper, and HR; led the migration
  from SAP BW 3.5 to BW 7.4 on HANA.
- Built a machine-learning talent-intelligence engine on SAP HCM: candidate suggestions, positions at
  risk, training recommendations and turnover reduction.
- Owned security, backups, load monitoring and development processes; led BI project teams.

### Earlier roles · 2000s – 2008

SAP BW Analyst and infrastructure at Cimpor Cimentos de Portugal · Data Warehouse Administrator at
Gillette do Brasil (P&G) · Network and Windows server administration at ACSP.

## Projects

### Finance & data platforms
- **12true** (personal project, 2026 – present): household finance platform on a double-entry ledger, with
  bank sync (Plaid), receipt reading, US tax organizers and an LLM assistant. Django, PostgreSQL, React;
  ~1,700 automated tests, 46 ADRs.

### Open books
- **SaaS Handbook** (2026): managing and operating SaaS for small teams; the repository is its own example.
  Quarto, GitHub Actions. [garon-sys.github.io/saas-handbook](https://garon-sys.github.io/saas-handbook/)
- **Bioinformatics Handbook** (2026): bioinformatics for human genetics, from molecular biology to GWAS,
  rare variants, pharmacogenomics and knowledge graphs. [andrerico.github.io/Bioinformatics](https://andrerico.github.io/Bioinformatics/)

### Genomic data systems
- **Biofilter** (2025 – 2026): versioned knowledge platform over 17 public sources; frozen Parquet bundles
  queried with DuckDB, no database server. [github.com/RitchieLab/biofilter](https://github.com/RitchieLab/biofilter)
- **IGEM** (2022 – present): gene–exposure knowledge base with 25 ETL pipelines, FastAPI, Python client
  and public website. [github.com/HallLab/IGEM](https://github.com/HallLab/IGEM)
- **MyNHANES** (2024): ingestion, harmonization and rule-based transformation of NHANES survey data
  across cycles; Django, SQLite. [github.com/HallLab/MyNHANES](https://github.com/HallLab/MyNHANES)
- **PharmCAT** (2024 – present): cross-platform testing and pipeline templates for the open-source
  pharmacogenomics tool. [pharmcat.clinpgx.org](https://pharmcat.clinpgx.org/)
- **Penn Medicine BioBank research** (2024 – present): rare-variant and ExWAS studies of hearing loss,
  ML for cardiovascular traits, and breast cancer research on 260,000+ participants.
